items.text: A big update arrives, as Tekken jumps into the ring, bringing the true KING Lancer and we introduce Blackcrest, a whole new mode that will task you with upgrading your car’s tech as you progress through a series of missions.

Tekken 8 arrives ready to put up a fight! We bring you some exclusive Decals, featuring top fighters like Jin, Kazuya, Reina, Lili, or Yoshimitsu and introducing the one and only Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution X Tekken 8 ED!
A new Tekken-inspired mode turns the track into a ring. Win a best-of-three match by crashing into opponents to KO them, or have the most life when time runs out to claim victory.
Arriving 2 weeks after season start, we bring the largest event of the year: Blackcrest.

Accept the invite from the exclusive Blackcrest Society and become their newest Agent. You’ll advance through a series of missions in this new roguelite mode, as you upgrade your car in between missions to face (and survive) greater challenges!
Climb through their ranks and soon you’ll be unlocking your very own Bugatti Tourbillon!
Experience some Deja-Boo as our Spookiest of Spotlights returns!
Race under Chuthulhu’s gaze in our tire-ific event for a chance to unlock the Praga Bohema and Porsche 911 Turbo 50 Years.
We have 2 new cars receiving the EVO treatment this update: The Porsche 911 Carrera RS 3.8 and the McLaren P1.

We’re breathing new life into all the Class Cardpacks, as all of their contents have been updated with more recent cars to continue building your garages.
It’s too big of a list to feature here but all the new card packs are now available for you to explore ingame before the season starts.
In case you missed it, we’ve already published a full blog going into detail of all the Multiplayer changes headed your way this season.
You can catch up by clicking here.
We’ve also taken another stab at making the Multiplayer name tags less obtrusive during live races.
Have a look in race and let us know your thoughts!
We’re also showing some love to our Clubs!
Starting with the next update, we’re smoothing the Reputation curve for Club Milestones so progression feels more organic and no longer has spikes in Reputation required for each milestone.
We have also taken some time also to buff the Milestone rewards, including BPs, EIPs, more card packs and credits for you to claim.
The Ad reward caps have been increased and now you’ll be able to access higher rewards and multipliers when finishing 1st in races.
As we get ready for the launch of the iPhone Duo and in accordance with Appstore guidelines, we will be dropping support for iOS 13.0 from October 21st, 2026 onwards.

items.text: Better do some cardio and stretch those thumbs, because this season is all about Endurance!
IMSA arrives for our Spotlight Event with an all-new mode and we have a few other special events that might steal the spotlight.

We bring you a taste of Endurance racing in the IMSA Spotlight. A brand-new mode will have you choose from amongst some classic endurance cars, such as the Aston Martin Valkyrie AMR Pro, the Ferrari 499P Modificata, the Mercedes-Benz C11, and the McLaren 650s GT, and join your virtual Team! You will race alongside them to beat the opposing teams and jostle your way to victory by racing on the "Endurance" versions of our tracks!
BURST OF SPEED

4 Time Limited events will make an appearance this season for this fan favorite format! You’ll race for a chance to get your hands on the Bugatti Centodieci, the Koenigsegg Regera, the Rimac Nevera R, the Bugatti Chiron Super Sport 300+, the Koenigsegg Gemera and the Koenigsegg One:1. These of course will be featured in the Burst of Speed Special Event, where you’ll race for the Mosler Super GT as the grand prize!

IMSA Endurance Mode Spotlight Event (Sep 15, 2026 - Oct 14, 2026): An all-new Spotlight event in collaboration with IMSA that aims to bring you the spirit of Endurance Racing! Pick your team and race alongside them against other teams on our custom endurance versions of our tracks. You’ll be able to choose your ride amongst the Aston Martin Valkyrie AMR Pro, the Ferrari 499P Modificata, the Mercedes-Benz C11, or the McLaren 650S GT3.

Mercedes-Benz C11 EVO Special Event (Sep 15, 2026 - Sep 29, 2026): We’re bringing it back for another run! Now that’ve you’ve had a bit more time to upgrade the C11, let’s see if you can put those EVO tuning options to the test.

Toyota GT-One Road Version Special Event (Sep 15, 2026 - Sep 30, 2026): It’s time for our newest Toyota to shine in our latest Special Event, featuring the new Toyota GT-One Road Version, alongside the Ferrari 599XX EVO, the Ferrari Enzo Ferrari, the Apollo N, the Ferrari F8 Tributo, the McLaren F1LM, and the Lamborghini Temerario.
Kimera EVO37 Grand Prix (Sep 22, 2026 - Oct 9, 2026): The Kimera Evo37 returns to the even that saw its debut. Time for a Grand Prix!

Mosler SuperGT Burst of Speed Special Event (Sep 25, 2026 - Oct 16, 2026): A new Burst of Speed arrives! Race for the Mosler SuperGT making use of the Koenigsegg Regera, the Bugatti Centodieci, the Bugatti Chiron Super Sport 300+, the Rimac Nevera R, the Koenigsegg One:1, and the Koenigsegg Gemera. Make sure to not miss out on the Burst of Speed TLEs to complete your progress!
Special Hunt: Ultima RS (Sep 28, 2026 - Oct 13, 2026): A Special hunt for a fan-favorite, the Ultima RS.

Mini-Mayhem (Oct 5, 2026 - Oct 14, 2026): Remember our Mayhem Events? Introducing: Mini-Mayhem! An express edition with fantastic rewards, that will have you race aboard the Lotus E-R9, the Zenvo TSR-S, and the Pagani Utopia Coupe. Get ready for some (Mini)Mayhem!

Special Hunt: Techrules AT96 Track Version (Oct 7, 2026 - Oct 22, 2026): Our final special hunt of the season brings the Techrules AT96 Track Version, so get your car ready as it’s huntin’ season again.

Starway: Ferrari LaFerrari Aperta (Sep 15, 2026 - Oct 14, 2026): And we almost forgot the Starway (ok fine, we did, edited last minute) where you'll have a chance to unlock the Ferrari LaFerrari Aperta, while racing aboard the Ferrari LaFerrari, the McLaren P1, the Ferrari F12tdf, and the Vencer Sarthe.

Oktober FAST TLE (Sep 18, 2026 - Sep 30, 2026): Celebrate the most german of traditions aboard the Noble M600 Speedster, the RAESR Tachyon Speed, and the Pininfarina H2 Speed.: Zicke zacke, zicke zacke, hoi hoi hoi!
Star Hunt: Sesto Elemento (Sep 22, 2026 - Oct 3, 2026): This season’s Star hunt features Lamborghini Sesto Elemento. You know the drill, get your Blueprints!

Burst of Speed TLEs (Sep 25, 2026 - Oct 9, 2026): A series of TLEs will accompany the start of our Burst of Speed, so get cracking on the Koenigsegg Gemera - Koenigsegg One:1, Rimac Nevera R - Bugatti Chiron Super Sport 300+, and Bugatti Centodieci - Koenigsegg Regera TLEs.
Epic Hunt: Sesto Elemento (Oct 3, 2026 - Oct 14, 2026): As the Star Hunt ends, the Epic Hunt arrives! Get your import parts for the Lamborghini Sesto Elemento.
Dragon TLE (China Golden Week) (Sep 30, 2026 - Oct 8, 2026): We’re celebrating China’s Golden Week with the McLaren 570S Spider, the Lamborghini Invencible, and the Bugatti Eb110. Enjoy the break!

World Animal Day TLE (Oct 5, 2026 - Oct 11, 2026): As every year, we like to celebrate World Animal Day with a healthy dose of animal inspired car-puns. Save the day aboard the Aspark Owl, the Jaguar F-Type SVR, and the Porsche 718 Cayman. Rawr.

We’re going to be applying a direct buff to the credits included in the Ultimate Legend Pass.
The Ultimate Legend Pass will now include a total of 20,000,000 Credits, increased from the current 10M included in the pass.
Ghost Slipstream is back baby! We’ve been listening to your feedback and we’re bringing back Ghost Slipstream into the mode rotation.
As you experienced at the end of last season, you will see the mode return every other MP Round, rotating with Ghost and No Takedowns, guaranteeing we always end the season with Ghost Slipstream.
So the new rotation will look something like: Classic- Ghost Slipstream - No Takedowns - Ghost Slipstream.
We’re reverting our previous change and console players will now have access to 20 tickets to claim ad rewards each day, instead of 8.
In case you missed it, a new TLE made its debut at the end of last season.
Returning this season (and every season from now on) the Club Series will make an appearance over the last weekend of each season.
Get your Club Mates involved for an easy challenge to get a quick boost of credits and a few Blueprints to boot. Check our Season Events Calendar for all the details!
A new season arrives powered by Pellets! PAC-MAN is taking the drivers seat and Team Ghost will be hunting him down in the Spotlight event!

The new Spotlight features a new exclusive game mode, where you will embody the spirit of PAC-MAN and try to gobble as many pellets as you can. But beware! Team Ghost are also nitro-powered and ready to hunt you down.
Don’t worry, you still have your secret weapon. Gobble down a Power Pellet and watch the tables turn as you chase down the Ghosts to teach them a lesson.
Your mission is clear.
Race. Eat. Repeat.

We know we had a rocky start with the Gauntlet last season but don’t worry. There will be no changes in rewards or the shop.
In the future, we will be bringing some much requested variety into our tracks, as track variants for Chicago, San Diego, India and Mt. Fuji will be added to the mix!
We’ve heard you loud and clear and we’ll be lifting our foot from the gas a bit.
The format is back to a single featured new car, the Porsche 718 Cayman PACMAN Edition, and you’ll be able to play on all stages. You’ll have no excuse to keep the chase going!

We’re buffing the Legend Pass! This upcoming season the pass will include an extra 2,500,000 Credits to claim. 1,000,000 Credits in Tier 1 of the premium track, and 1,500,000 Credits in Tier 24 of the premium track. This season’s BP rewards will be dedicated to the new Porsche 718 Cayman PACMAN Edition to help you make it even further in the Spotlight Event.
Our Legends playing on consoles will see their Ad Bonus Ticket limits increase from 8 to 12.
We’re bringing the fan-favorite Ghost Slipstream game mode back to the Multiplayer rotation! It joins the MP1 rotation starting August 18th, 2026.
We’re giving Multiplayer milestone rewards a boost this season!

The total Credits obtainable through Multiplayer milestones are increasing from 2,000,000 to 3,500,000 Credits. Players with the Multiplayer Bonus Pass can also earn an additional 3,500,000 Credits, up from 2,000,000.
This means players who progress through the Multiplayer leagues can now earn up to 7,000,000 Credits from Multiplayer milestone rewards with the Multiplayer Bonus Pass.
An all new Update arrives, packed with 3 new Seasons, each featuring a brand-new game mode and exciting collaborations!

Today we’ll be taking a close look at our first season, Touge Masters, which comes with the majestic Mt. Fuji track, and the JDM Turbofest Spotlight, featuring a new game mode which will have you Drifting your way to victory!

We’re headed to Japan, just in time for our JDM Event. Created as a tribute to Touge and the birthplace of competitive drifting, you’ll be able to both enjoy the breathtaking vistas and scenery, or get in the zone speeding down long straights or taking the loop bridge with a curve to rival Thousand Minarets!
Our Japanese Domestic Market event is all about DRIFTING! Hit the drift gates and rack up points to become a true master of the drifting arts and dominate in the JDM Turbofest Spotlight!

items.text: The Asphalt team has deployed a new hotfix today.

It includes fixes for several crashes reported on Steam (both PC and MacOS), alongside fixes for an issue on GooglePlay which was causing some users to experience a black screen crash, and crashing issues on iOS Gen 9 iPads.
We hope this helps resolve your issues and thank you for your patience and understanding.

items.text: Our latest update brought a few more bumps in the road than we’d planned for and, given the opportunity, the Asphalt Team are also bringing some of our planned economy balance changes alongside it.

Why now you ask? Since we have a new season coming, the hotfix allows us to deploy these changes earlier than our next update and gives us more time to collect your feedback for any future changes or adjustments.
As we mentioned in our 2026 Roadmap, rebalancing our economy is one of our main objectives and one that we will continue to work on and evolve throughout the year.
So, please remember, we’ll be paying attention to both your feedback and the impact these changes have in-game so we can continue to tweak and adapt any plans or adjustments.
The Hotfix will be released tomorrow, April 23rd at 10:00 GMT+2, with our new season set to start as planned on Tuesday, 28th of April.
Now, let’s start things off by having a look at what’s coming your way next season.
We’re excited to announce the return of hololive as they prepare for their final encore this season. One last big show and your last chance to get your favorite decals and emojis!

Mayhem Event Ares Panther: (05/05 - 28/05) Time for some Mayhem! Get your hands on the brand-new Ares Panther, the McLaren 600LT Spider, the Pagani Zonda Cinque, the Aston Martin DBS GT Zagato, the McLaren 650s GT3, the Ford GT MK IV, and the Mercedes-Benz Mercedes-AMG ONE.

Now, time to have a look at what is coming in our Hotfix, releasing tomorrow, 23rd of April at 10:00 GMT+2
First things first, let’s deal with the “fix” part! Here's the list of all the fixes included in our upcoming hotfix:
Floaty issue has been fixed: Good news! Your drift will no longer be interrupted by 360s or other tricks you perform on the track.
Crash Fixes across all platforms: The team has been able to resolve several issues that were causing the game to crash for some of our players, particularly those playing on Steam and the Epic store.
IOS Age verification Issue: Resolved an issue for some iOS players when facing an Age verification pop-up.
Empty Rewards Tab for Multiplayer: Multiplayer rewards were not showing for some players. This has been fixed.
Season Pass not appearing for some players: This should also be resolved, and the Season Pass should display correctly for all.
India Track Respawn Issue: Some players reported being respawned while in the air on some sections of the track.
Scotland Ramps: The crew managed to wrangle back those wild ramps that had appeared on the Scotland track. They’re back in the pen now, and all is back to normal.
Shop not appearing in Bluestacks: The shop should now be back as normal.
Leaderboard issues: The leaderboards were not updating correctly for some Ranked TLEs and a few Club sections. We’ve resolved the issue, and they should now populate correctly.

We will be tweaking our current Ads reward system, as currently we feel it may create an awkward experience. We want our events to be an experience rewarding and engaging enough for you to dedicate your time on, instead of having to focus on grinding stages to trigger ads.

We're taking measures to help players who need credits the most. Starting next season, players who are in earlier stages of their progression will see a boost in the credits they receive from credit multipliers. In the next update, we'll have the tools ready to fine-tune and extend that benefit to players in short supply of credits at any point of their journey.

We also overestimated the average amount of ads players normally watch, providing an unfair advantage to platforms without ads, as they can quickly go through 20 “ad tickets” a day, which very few of you end up benefiting from on platforms with ads.
So, to help level things out, platforms without ads will have their ad tickets reduced from 20 to 8, to better match the average experience amongst players.
As most of you are aware by now, we continue to work on fine tuning the contents of the Ultimate pass, and this time we have some exciting updates!
For this hotfix, and coming into play next season, we’ll be further changing the pass’ content, which will bring the Zenvo Aurora Tur as the featured car AND including the key for the Pagani Zonda R.
Already have the Zonda R? No worries, the key will be converted to 150,000 Trade Tokens, so you can still get some extra value from our Spotlights or Legends Store.

For the rest of the included rewards, we want to try and offer more active value and upgrades, compared to just adding more bulk resources, so have a look at the Ultimate Pass once the new season comes and let us know what you think of the changes!

We will also be tweaking event rewards from a season perspective, making sure we balance overall rewards from season to season, instead of from event to event. As we see players mostly focusing their time on our big ticket events, such as the Spotlight and Drive Syndicate which require time and dedication, we want to make sure that time is worthwhile spent, so we’ll be tweaking our reward distribution for Spotlights, Drive Syndicates and other Special Events.
Speaking of Drive Syndicate, the SC relays will be gaining 2 new steps at a premium, for those who need an extra boost in a rush.
We’ve heard you and agree that the new community car needs a bit more “umph!”. You can check the new stats here:
Didn’t we say we wanted to make playing events feel better than chasing multipliers?

Well, our next season will be coming with a new MAYHEM event, and for the first time ever, featuring a brand-new car: The Ares Panther! Check out our season event calendar above for the exact dates so you don't miss out.

Thank you to all our dedicated players who poured their hearts into our multiplayer feedback thread on the Discord channel. It helped us better understand the impact of the changes and review our plans to better adapt to your expectations and how you play the game.
So, as a first step, we’ll be bringing back rewards for the Top 25,000 players! Yep, you read that right; we’re not only bringing back the top 10k rewards but expanding it to Top 25k rewards.

Our initial changes were aimed at making multiplayer even more competitive, but we missed the mark. We have further increased the goal posts, to make sure that Multiplayer isn’t just rewarding our top players and gives a reason for everyone to give it a shot and try their best!
We also heard your thoughts on the current filters and have also readjusted them.

The new filters will kick in at the start of our next MP event next season, and will take a more nuanced approach to determine what cars should be included in each, instead of basing it purely off a car’s rank. This will hopefully lead to more fair matchups and mitigate the impact of EVO cars.
Of course, we will still be keeping a close eye on your feedback throughout the season to see if further changes are needed.

As players can unlock more cars each season nowadays, we’re also boosting the Token to Credits exchange rate to receive more than double (and almost four times in some cases) the number of credits you used to get, so you don’t get stuck when trying to upgrade your new rides.
Those are all the changes included in our upcoming Hotfix, some of which you’ll get to experience in our new upcoming season.
Please remember that our goal is to iterate and evolve these changes, until we hit the sweet spot.
And to get there, we need your feedback and impressions.
Although first impressions are important, please continue to let us know as time moves on how you feel about the changes as we’ll be paying close attention to the Discord server and our socials!

Built with you. Engineered by Porsche.

Thanks to all of your extensive feedback, we'll be reining in a few of our EVO car stat boosts, as they seem to be punching higher than intended:

items.text: Although we rarely do this, a new Update is coming this season, to introduce one of our most ambitious features to date: EVO Tuning!
Our brand new feature adds a new layer of tuning and power for some classic cars!
For our first foray, EVO Tuning will be available for the Bugatti Chiron, the Ferrari Enzo Ferrari and the Chevrolet Camaro LT.
Once you max these cars, you will automatically unlock the new EVO feature and be able to access it directly from the garage.
The EVO feature will allow you to collect new items that unlock new driving experiences for your car:
Collect Items: Each car will have access to its own EVO shop, allowing you to unlock EVO items such as new engines, drivetrains, nitro systems, etc.
Create your build: Each item will have a different weight, and the total weight of your car will heavily impact how it performs on the track.
Fine Tuning: Specific items can provide boosts to key areas, so adapt your choice to your driving style!
We'll be looking forward to all your feedback and impressions in our Discord Channel to help us fine tune and balance this feature so it can evolve it into something special.
Yes. Pun fully intended. See you in Discord!
When accessing the new EVO Tuning menus, you'll have direct acces to the new EVO Shop.
It will feature all the available EVO Items for that car from the start, and you'll be able to spend tickets to choose which Item to reveal and keep first!
A bit of luck and you'll have your dream build in no time!
4 EVO Shop tickets for that car will be automatically earned as soon as you Max your car.
You'll be able to earn more tickets through gameplay, the shop and we even included some in the Legend Pass!

The launch of Unite along with cross-play functionality has brought a renewed focus on multiplayer. From now on, we want our Multiplayer mode to feel more dynamic and varied, as we include regular updates to ensure it feels fresh and exciting.
Of course, we’ll be paying close attention to player feedback to make sure our changes are hitting the right notes.
On release, we’ll be introducing 2 new permanent Multiplayer Modes: World League, and Season Series.

Our core competitive mode. More veteran players will recognize this as our expansion on our classic World Series. With all our players uniting under one roof, and having more players competing together, we knew we needed to expand our current multiplayer and breathe some new life into it, as our players have been requesting for some time.

notes.title: The main changes coming to our competitive mode are

items.text: Car Filters: Not all cars will be available to compete, and we’ll be changing our car rosters from event to event to keep them fresh. We also won’t be grouping cars solely based on car class, but more based on their car rank. This will allow for more balanced and interesting car selections

Sub-tiers: As we get ready for all our players to finally compete together, each tier will be broken into Sub-tiers, allowing for a larger number of players to compete and still provide meaningful progression.
New format Structure: The World League will offer the competitive experience year-round over a total of 6 Splits in the following structure:
Rounds: Competitive events lasting 2 weeks. Once complete you'll be able to claim your rewards for the Round and all players will be slightly demoted before the next round starts.
Split: A grouping made of 4 Rounds. Will aslo grant greater rewards upon completion and players will also be dropped in ranks before the next split starts.
Once a new round starts, players will start their competitive climb, gaining ranks as usual based on your performance.

Once the round ends, you'll be able to claim the final Round rewards. Player's total rank will also be slightly reduced before the next Round begins. Don't worry, you'll only lose a few sub tiers and won't be demoted entire Tiers at a time.
Once a Split ends, you'll be able to claim the final Split reards, based on your perfomance over the past 4 Rounds. After a split players will also suffer a demotion.

The end goal of course is to see how high you can climb within the competitive year! At the start of a new competitive year all competitive progress will be reset, and you'll be back to defend your claim for another year.
You can also expect to see a few changes in rules, settings and car rotations each round, but we'll share more info on that once we're closer to the events themselves, so keep your eyes peeled.
These changes will allow for a more finely grained level of competition, given our increase in players, and provide a longer progression system for all.

The inclusion of Sub-Tiers will also allow for more accurate matchmaking, along with allowing us to reward players each step of the way as they unlock unique rewards and additions to the car filter. It might be a longer goal to aim for, but we’ll make it worth it every step of the way.
Furthermore, changing our philosophy on car filters will let us break the barriers of class filters and allow for some unique matchups yet to be seen in a competitive environment.
We hope this will also allow for a more new-player friendly introduction to the competitive series, while allowing more balanced and epic matchups in our higher Tiers.
A new multiplayer series that allows for a more casual experience!
Here we want to offer a more relaxed and open experience, free from restrictions and car filters and allowing you to face the rest of the Asphalt Community with anything you have in your garage.
Of course, we will still be matchmaking you against cars with a similar rank, but you’ll be free to practice on whichever car you own and get some action on your favorite rides.
These events will last a week, and offer rewards based on your series score.
